Landed as Gerrit 3141 (merged 38f5b6c262f8, 2026-10-29 17:13 PDT) at LLM-Review +1 / Verified +1. Deploy verified read-only via SSM on i-00880b2c7f13527c5: container rebar-mcp-38f5b6c262f8-8093 started 2026-10-29 17:16:18 PDT with log driver journald, and `journalctl -t rebar-mcp -n 3` returned its output:
Oct 30 00:16:48 ip-172-31-7-214.ec2.internal rebar-mcp[1901]: INFO: 127.0.0.1:47024 - "GET /health HTTP/1.1" 200 OK
Oct 30 00:17:18 ip-172-31-7-214.ec2.internal rebar-mcp[1901]: INFO: 127.0.0.1:49552 - "GET /health HTTP/1.1" 200 OK
Oct 30 00:17:49 ip-172-31-7-214.ec2.internal rebar-mcp[1901]: INFO: 127.0.0.1:50670 - "GET /health HTTP/1.1" 200 OK
The prior container (rebar-mcp-ded208db10c5-8092) used json-file and journalctl returned no entries. File-impact note: docs/mcp-reference.md is generated, so the log-location docs went into docs/mcp-client-setup.md (Troubleshooting) instead. The parity test test_docker_run_matches_compose_mcp_logging fails against the pre-change autodeploy.sh and passes with it.
